sloka: यश्चावरो भवेत्ताभ्यां लवेन स समाहितः ।निर्मार्जनीयो वृद्धाभिर्लव इत्येव नामतः ।। ७.६६.८ ॥
transliteration: yaścāvaro bhavettābhyāṁ lavena sa samāhitaḥ ।nirmārjanīyo vṛddhābhirlava ityeva nāmataḥ ।। 7.66.8 ॥

translations.english: And the one who was younger of the two, he was carefully purified with a piece (of Kuśa grass) by the old women, and thus he was named Lava.
